triggers.name: parsed_data
triggers.title: Parsed data
triggers.help: Fetches trigger events as soon as they occur.

input.name: from
input.label: From
input.hint: Get parsed data from documents uploaded since the selected date/time. Leave empty to get parsed data from documents uploaded one hour ago

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Docparser action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Docparser connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: fetch_document_from_url
actions.title: Fetch document from URL
actions.description: Fetch document from URL in docparser

input.name: url
input.label: Source file URL
input.hint: URL of a publicly accessible document

input.name: remote_id
input.label: Your Document ID
input.hint: Use this field to pipe your own document ID through the Docparser process
